Nour El Idrissi
Junior Full-Stack Developer (TypeScript, Python, LLMs)
Fes, Morocco · nour.elidrissi@example.com · https://github.com/example-nour

PROFILE
Recent Computer Science graduate with a 6-month full-stack internship and several shipped side projects that use LLM APIs.

EXPERIENCE
Full-Stack Developer Intern, Medina Pay (fintech startup), Fes · Feb 2025 – Jul 2025
- Built React and TypeScript screens for the merchant dashboard, connected to a Node.js (Express) REST API.
- Wrote PostgreSQL migrations and SQL reports for the finance team.
- Wrote Jest unit tests for the payment-reconciliation module and fixed 30+ bugs from the backlog.
- Worked in a Git flow with pull requests and code reviews on GitHub.

PROJECTS
StudyBuddy, AI flashcard generator (Next.js, Cloudflare Workers, Gemini API) · 2025
- Generates flashcards from lecture PDFs with the Gemini API and stores decks in Cloudflare D1; used by about 200 students at my university.

JobFeed API (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL) · 2024
- REST API that aggregates public job feeds, deduplicates postings and exposes search endpoints; deployed on a Linux VPS.

Portfolio site (Next.js, Tailwind CSS) · 2024

EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Fes Institute of Computing · 2021 – 2025

SKILLS
Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, SQL
Frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, FastAPI, Tailwind CSS
Data: PostgreSQL, Cloudflare D1
Tools: Git, GitHub, Jest, Linux, Cloudflare Workers
AI: Gemini API, OpenAI API, prompt engineering
Spoken languages: Arabic (native), French (fluent), English (fluent)
jobText:
Full-Stack Engineer
Veloria · Remote within the European Union · Full-time

Veloria is a Paris-based company that builds invoicing and payment software for European freelancers. 40,000 freelancers use us every month.

Your mission
- Build product features across our TypeScript back end and React front end.
- Own services end to end: design, tests, deployment and monitoring.

Must have
- 3+ years of professional experience as a full-stack engineer.
- TypeScript and Node.js on the back end.
- React on the front end.
- PostgreSQL.
- Automated testing (unit and integration tests).
- Experience with message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka or SQS).
- Running services on AWS in production.
- Professional English.

Nice to have
- French.
- Docker.
- GraphQL.

Location
Remote within the European Union. You must already have the right to work in the EU: we cannot sponsor visas. We meet in Paris twice a year (travel paid).

Salary: 55,000–70,000 EUR + equity.
